profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: I am an alumni from the University of Michigan with a BS in Computer Science and a minor in Asian Studies. I am experienced in developing applications in .NET framework, Python, Go, and Java. I am also qualified in architecting efficient solutions in the cloud using AWS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, tested, and deployed robust C# programs that automated the backend processes of the mortgage industry, averaging thousands of transactions a day
• Integrated Microsoft Outlook, Twilio, and client’s APIs in project implementation to automate communications between users, eliminating the use of manual requests and reducing loan pricing adjustment time by over 90%
• Applied the template pattern, inheritance relationships, and composition to avoid code duplication and adhere to the Open Closed Principle
• Designed and executed automated test cases using the NUnit framework and libraries such as Moq
• Performed client-facing responsibilities such as gathering detailed requirements, designing customer
solutions, and collaborating on User Acceptance Testing

positions.title: Cyber Security / Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented Python scripts to record/monitor the status of ECUs during fuzz tests and perform necessary power cycles, reducing fuzz test analyzing time by 50%
• Utilized multithreading to parse very large test logs and filter network packets using WireShark
• Automated fuzz test report creation using Python and Jinja2 by rendering JSON data in formatted PDFs, eliminating manual, inconsistent reports and facilitating root cause analysis process
• Implemented Umap2 to integrate USB device fuzzing compatibility with proprietary CAN fuzzer

honors.title: U.S. Department of Education Foreign Language and Area Studies (FLAS) Fellowship
University of Michigan Regents Merit Scholarship Recipient

volunteerExperiences.description: Facilitated learning events for children and adults visiting the Hands-On Museum
